messages:
maria: Pushed v1.7.0 candidate notes. Main items: Adaptive routing GA, embeddings streaming opt-in, and SDK example updates. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1512
devin: skimmed hero + bullets, looks good. Quick note — changelog index links to 'Adaptive routing' and 'Embeddings streaming' sometimes navigate to page top on preview. Repro on Firefox + mobile.
cheng: that's the new markdown-it anchor behavior after the renderer upgrade. heading ids are slugged differently.
anya: can we add a small known-issue line in the draft? something like: "Known issue: changelog anchors may not always jump to the section on staging due to heading id normalization changes. Workaround: use browser find or direct permalinks"
maria: yup, i'll add that under Known Issues with an ETA: fix expected in the next deploy (~45m).
devin: SDK snippets in the draft still show create_embedding(model='x') — our latest SDK requires model_id and returns a embeddings list. i'll push a tiny snippet patch.
cheng: i'll open a tiny slugify+redirects PR to map old heading ids to new ones and avoid breaking published links. Will include a small migration note in the changelog.
release-bot: Preview build: https://deploy-preview-1512--docs.redwood.com — status: linkcheck FAILED (3 broken anchors)
release-bot: linkcheck output:
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #adaptive-routing
ERROR: /changelog/index.html: missing anchor #embeddings-streaming
ERROR: /sdk/python/examples.html: missing anchor #python-sdk-examples
maria: thanks — i'll mark the release as candidate and add the developer notes section listing snippet diffs + migration steps.
cheng: PR 1513 opened for slugify + redirects: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1513 — includes node slugifier and _redirects additions.
devin: patched SDK snippets on PR1512 branch and added a short code diff in the Developer notes.
anya: once PR1513 merges, we should re-run linkcheck and remove the known-issue note before final publish.
maria: agreed. leaving the note in for now. tagging legal for the banner text. closing thread unless linkcheck returns more errors. :v:
